as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n-legend" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacingLeft=4;" value="1 Devices (EST), Windows clients and MDM (SCEP), relying parties (CRL, OCSP) and the administrator (revoke) call the front door.
2 The front door forwards to ApiFunction with an origin secret. CloudFront is the default; Function URL, HTTP API and REST API are the alternatives.
3 ApiFunction reads and writes DynamoDB one item at a time, publishes CRLs to the private S3 bucket, and checks Basic auth against Cognito (InitiateAuth).
4 ApiFunction signs with the issuing CA keys held in Parameter Store, Secrets Manager or KMS, chosen per CA.
5 ApiFunction and BootstrapFunction write ECS JSON records to CloudWatch Logs.
6 cdk deploy runs a CloudFormation custom resource, which creates or updates BootstrapFunction.
7 BootstrapFunction creates the CAs and keys (the root key is reachable by the bootstrap role only) and writes CAs and CRLs to State.
8 A daily EventBridge rule refreshes the CRL through ApiFunction and rotates keys through BootstrapFunction." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="1240" x="40" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: AWS Cloud: one account and region, one CDK stack
CA keys and secrets (chosen per CA)
about $1 per key per month, not exportable

g.text: 1 Devices (EST), Windows clients and MDM (SCEP), relying parties (CRL, OCSP) and the administrator (revoke) call the front door.
2 The front door forwards to ApiFunction with an origin secret. CloudFront is the default; Function URL, HTTP API and REST API are the alternatives.
3 ApiFunction reads and writes DynamoDB one item at a time, publishes CRLs to the private S3 bucket, and checks Basic auth against Cognito (InitiateAuth).
4 ApiFunction signs with the issuing CA keys held in Parameter Store, Secrets Manager or KMS, chosen per CA.
5 ApiFunction and BootstrapFunction write ECS JSON records to CloudWatch Logs.
6 cdk deploy runs a CloudFormation custom resource, which creates or updates BootstrapFunction.
7 BootstrapFunction creates the CAs and keys (the root key is reachable by the bootstrap role only) and writes CAs and CRLs to State.
8 A daily EventBridge rule refreshes the CRL through ApiFunction and rotates keys through BootstrapFunction.
